clientHourRule: Clients MUST use h = floor((unixSeconds - 600) / 3600) (10 min backdating) so modest clock skew and hour-boundary races stay inside the server window {cur-1, cur}. The server accepts ONLY cur and cur-1.

clientContract: Liveness: send the TEXT frame exactly "ping" at least every 30 s (server answers "pong"). WebSocket-protocol pings (URLSessionWebSocketTask.sendPing) do NOT count; silence >90 s closes the connection. 2 h hard cap cuts active sessions: reconnect with the SAME session id s. s = 16 random bytes base64url, fresh per (token, app run), never reused across tokens.
